analysis.title: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. (BMY): 3Q26 First Take — Modest Beat and Raise, Although Relatively Uneventful
key_insights: BMY reported 3Q26 total revenue of $13.1bn ($13,096mn) vs GS $12.9bn and consensus (Visible Alpha) $12.7bn, a beat of 1.4% vs GS and 3.1% vs consensus.
3Q26 EPS (adjusted, including guided IPR&D) was $1.35 vs GS $1.16 and consensus $1.20, a beat of 16.8% vs GS and 12.9% vs consensus.

Adj. EBIT ex. IPR&D was $4,920mn vs GS $4,675mn and consensus $4,569mn (+5.2%/+7.7%). The beat came mainly from SG&A of $1,699mn vs GS $1,821mn (-6.7%) and a slightly lower R&D line, while gross margin of 68.6% was slightly below GS 68.8%.
The company raised FY26 revenue guidance from $49.0bn-$50.0bn to $49.75bn-$50.25bn, +$500mn at the mid-point.

GS views results as incrementally positive and within expectations. Product-level variances were generally in line. Eliquis was $4,690mn (-0.9% vs GS, +1.5% vs consensus) and Sotyktu was $100mn, a 22.4% beat vs GS and 16.1% vs consensus.
Cobenfy was the main product miss at $57mn vs GS $70mn and consensus $68mn (-18.6%/-15.6%).
Several legacy products beat: Revlimid $303mn vs GS $267mn (+13.6%), Sprycel $73mn vs GS $52mn (+40.9%), Abraxane $65mn vs GS $37mn (+77.1%). Orencia was $983mn vs GS $1,019mn (-3.5%).

GS expects upcoming clinical readouts to matter more for investor psychology than quarterly numbers. Milvexian SSP and Sotyktu SLE remain listed as 2026 events, Milvexian Afib and Cobenfy ADEPT remain in 2027, and GS expects incremental Cobenfy data at CTAD.

Expected focus of the 8am ET call: preliminary 2027 outlook, clinical readout color, Pumitamig updates and read-across from SMMT/Akeso HARMONi and AZN/Daiichi AVANZAR 1L mNSCLC readouts, commercial execution, and updated framing on business development.

GS rates BMY Neutral with a 12-month price target of $63 (10.0x Q5-Q8 EPS estimates) vs a $60.57 close on 28 Oct 2026, 4.0% upside. GS forecasts FY26E EPS of $6.45 and FY27E EPS of $6.83, with revenue falling to $42.5bn in 2028E.

market_movers.rationale: Routine reiteration after a modest 3Q26 beat and a revenue guidance raise. The target of $63 implies 4.0% upside from $60.57, and the near-term focus is on clinical readouts.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees BMY's quarter as incrementally positive and within expectations, with pipeline readouts (milvexian, Cobenfy, Sotyktu SLE) driving sentiment more than quarterly numbers.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 total revenue reported $13,096mn vs GS est $12,916mn and Visible Alpha consensus est $12,706mn (reported 10/29/2026 pre-market).
3Q26 adjusted EPS including guided IPR&D reported $1.35 vs GS est $1.16 and consensus est $1.20.
3Q26 Adj. EBIT ex. IPR&D reported $4,920mn vs GS est $4,675mn and consensus est $4,569mn. SG&A was 13.0% of revenue vs GS est 14.1%, and R&D was 18.1% vs GS est 18.5%.
Gross margin reported 68.6% vs GS est 68.8% and consensus est 68.9%.
FY26 revenue guidance raised to $49.75bn-$50.25bn from $49.0bn-$50.0bn, a $500mn increase at the mid-point.
Cobenfy 3Q26 sales were $57mn reported vs GS est $70mn and consensus est $68mn. Sotyktu was $100mn vs GS est $82mn and consensus est $86mn.
GS quarterly EPS estimates: 9/26E $1.16 (pre-print), 12/26E $1.68, 3/27E $1.58. GS FY26E EPS is $6.45 and FY27E EPS is $6.83.
risk_factors: Upside: faster growth from the growth portfolio (Cobenfy, Camzyos, Reblozyl, Opdualag, Breyanzi), better durability of the legacy portfolio, a smaller hit from LOEs and IRA implementation, more cost-cut flow-through, and stronger pipeline outcomes (Cobenfy in Alzheimer's disease psychosis, milvexian).

Downside: slower growth in the growth portfolio, faster erosion of the legacy portfolio, a larger negative impact from LOEs and IRA implementation, and negative pipeline outcomes (Cobenfy in Alzheimer's disease psychosis, milvexian AF).
